_comment: Voice cast for pilots and towers. "source" picks which id every role uses: "builtin" (ElevenLabs default voices, free plan), "designed" (custom voices from design_voices.py; saving them needs a paid plan) or "library" (your library picks; needs a paid plan). Roles missing the chosen id fall back to their built-in voice. "model_id" is the default model; a role can override it, and "style" is a v3 audio tag put in front of every line (only eleven_v3 reads tags).

design.description: Calm, authoritative American male air traffic controller in his fifties. Deep, measured voice, crisp clipped radio delivery, unhurried and completely in control.
design.text: Southwest twenty-four thirteen, Phoenix Tower, wind two six zero at eight, runway two six, cleared for takeoff.

design.description: Confident American male air traffic controller in his thirties. Brisk, efficient and slightly gravelly, fast clipped radio cadence, no wasted words.
design.text: American nineteen eighty-two, Phoenix Tower, runway two five left, cleared to land, traffic holding short.

design.description: Professional American female air traffic controller in her forties. Clear, firm and quick, friendly efficiency, crisp radio delivery.
design.text: SkyWest fifty-one forty, Phoenix Ground, runway two five right, taxi via Tango, Echo, hold short of two five left.

design.description: A middle-aged male airline captain from Mumbai, India, with a very strong, unmistakably Indian English accent and classic Indian intonation and rhythm. Warm, polite, confident, slightly formal, speaking over a cockpit radio.
design.text: Phoenix Tower, good evening sir, Air India one two one, established ILS two five left. Cleared to land two five left, Air India one two one, thank you very much.

design.description: Laid-back American male airline captain in his fifties with a relaxed Southern drawl. Friendly, unhurried, a little gravelly, speaking over a cockpit radio.
design.text: Afternoon Phoenix, Southwest twenty-four thirteen, holding short two six, ready to go. Cleared for takeoff two six, Southwest twenty-four thirteen.

design.description: Young American male first officer in his late twenties with a Midwestern accent. Energetic, quick and eager, speaking over a cockpit radio.
design.text: Phoenix Ground, Frontier nineteen sixty-five, gate B nine, ready to push. Taxi to two five right via Tango, Echo, Frontier nineteen sixty-five.

design.description: Older British male airline captain in his sixties with a refined, received-pronunciation English accent. Dry, unflappable and precise, speaking over a cockpit radio.
design.text: Phoenix Tower, good afternoon, Speedbird two eight niner, ten miles final two five left. Cleared to land, two five left, Speedbird two eight niner.

design.description: American male regional airline pilot in his thirties with a neutral accent. Matter-of-fact, steady, slightly tired at the end of a long day, speaking over a cockpit radio.
design.text: Phoenix Tower, Envoy thirty-four ten, on the visual two six. Runway two six, cleared to land, Envoy thirty-four ten, appreciate it.

design.description: Deep-voiced American male cargo pilot in his forties. Slow, low and gravelly, calm and economical, speaking over a cockpit radio.
design.text: Phoenix Tower, FedEx fourteen oh two heavy, eight mile final two five left. Two five left, cleared to land, FedEx fourteen oh two heavy.

design.description: Australian male airline pilot in his forties with a broad Australian accent. Cheerful, easygoing and confident, speaking over a cockpit radio.
design.text: G'day Phoenix Ground, Qantas seven niner, clear of two five left at Bravo. Taxi to gate F two via Bravo, Qantas seven niner, cheers.

design.description: American male airline captain in his forties with a smooth, polished West Coast accent. Relaxed authority, very clear diction, speaking over a cockpit radio.
design.text: Phoenix Tower, Alaska six forty-four, holding short two five left at Delta. Cross runway two five left at Delta, Alaska six forty-four.

design.description: American female airline captain in her thirties. Confident, clear and upbeat, crisp professional diction, speaking over a cockpit radio.
design.text: Phoenix Tower, Delta eleven twenty-two, ten miles out on the ILS two five left. Cleared to land two five left, Delta eleven twenty-two.

design.description: American female first officer in her forties with a slight Texan accent. Calm, warm and steady, speaking over a cockpit radio.
design.text: Phoenix Tower, United three oh seven, holding short two five right. Line up and wait, runway two five right, United three oh seven.
